question: Which Wave 2+ modular dashboard slices should remain bundled Control UI/Gateway work, and which should move to plugin or ClawHub distribution before implementation?
rationale: The tracker spans product direction, untrusted widget security, persistent state, install/publish trust, and role visibility boundaries that cleanup automation cannot choose safely.

options.title: Sponsor selective slices
options.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

options.title: Move optional pieces outward
options.body: Keep only generic core/API seams in OpenClaw and ask optional widget packs, skills, registries, or app bundles to ship through plugin or ClawHub paths.

options.title: Defer the roadmap
options.body: Pause the Wave 2+ tracker if maintainers decide bundled modular dashboards are not current product work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor selective slices
recommendation.body: Keep the tracker open, review linked child issues and PRs one by one, and require explicit storage and security boundaries before each merge.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history for the plugin-tab seam and the product/security boundary this roadmap builds on.
